task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the lower left to grasp and lift a pale, rounded, encapsulated mass attached to a reddish, vascularized tissue flap in the center of the frame. The background consists of yellowish, fatty omental tissue with visible red blood vessels on the left and a darker, congested, and irregular tissue bed on the upper right. As the instrument pulls the mass upward and slightly to the right, the attached tissue flap stretches, revealing its pinkish-red color and texture. The mass is held firmly, and the surrounding bowel loops, appearing as smooth, pale, tubular structures, are visible in the lower portion of the frame. The instrument then releases the mass, which falls back down, and the view shifts slightly, showing the now-exposed, raw, and dark red tissue bed where the mass was previously attached.

Task video description:
A laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the lower left to grasp and lift a pale, rounded, encapsulated mass attached to a reddish, vascularized tissue flap in the center of the frame. The background consists of yellowish, fatty omental tissue with visible red blood vessels on the left and a darker, congested, and irregular tissue bed on the upper right. As the instrument pulls the mass upward and slightly to the right, the attached tissue flap stretches, revealing its pinkish-red color and texture. The mass is held firmly, and the surrounding bowel loops, appearing as smooth, pale, tubular structures, are visible in the lower portion of the frame. The instrument then releases the mass, which falls back down, and the view shifts slightly, showing the now-exposed, raw, and dark red tissue bed where the mass was previously attached.

A laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the lower left to grasp and lift a pale, rounded, encapsulated mass attached to a reddish, vascularized tissue flap in the center of the frame. A laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the lower left to grasp and lift a pale, rounded, encapsulated mass attached to a reddish, vascularized tissue flap in the center of the frame. The background consists of yellowish, fatty omental tissue with visible red blood vessels on the left and a darker, congested, and irregular tissue bed on the upper right. As the instrument pulls the mass upward and slightly to the right, the attached tissue flap stretches, revealing its pinkish-red color and texture. The mass is held firmly, and the surrounding bowel loops, appearing as smooth, pale, tubular structures, are visible in the lower portion of the frame. The instrument then releases the mass, which falls back down, and the view shifts slightly, showing the now-exposed, raw, and dark red tissue bed where the mass was previously attached.

prompt.task_text:
Task video description:
A laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the lower left to grasp and lift a pale, rounded, encapsulated mass attached to a reddish, vascularized tissue flap in the center of the frame. The background consists of yellowish, fatty omental tissue with visible red blood vessels on the left and a darker, congested, and irregular tissue bed on the upper right. As the instrument pulls the mass upward and slightly to the right, the attached tissue flap stretches, revealing its pinkish-red color and texture. The mass is held firmly, and the surrounding bowel loops, appearing as smooth, pale, tubular structures, are visible in the lower portion of the frame. The instrument then releases the mass, which falls back down, and the view shifts slightly, showing the now-exposed, raw, and dark red tissue bed where the mass was previously attached.
